messages:
Ravi Patel: Heads-up — EU ingest lag just hit a big spike around 03:10 UTC. We started dropping late events into the streaming window and a bunch of aggregate dashboards look stale. Opening thread to coordinate a backfill plan. @Maya @Jonah can you triage?
Maya Chen: looking. initial probe: source X had a retry storm (downstream SQS burst) which caused out-of-order batches. A lot of events are arriving with old event_ts.
Jonah Lee: confirmed, I see a large backlog in the kafka partition consumer groups for tenant-prod-eu. Consumer lag peaked ~450k messages.
Elena Gomez: any immediate customer impact?
Ravi Patel: user-facing metrics (team dashboards & billing aggregates) are undercounting for a 2-hour window. Not critical SLA outage but unacceptable for dashboards.
Priya Nair: ops-bot alerted and auto-scaling added more workers but dedupe/ordering constraints prevented catch-up. We should plan a recompute/backfill rather than just replaying raw stream.
Maya Chen: agree. proposal: 1) freeze live aggregation writes for the affected window by applying a short hold, 2) snapshot current state, 3) run idempotent recompute job from raw Parquet for the window, 4) swap in results.
Jonah Lee: +1. but we need quota for recompute workers. Current backfill throttle in the console will block if we hit cluster-wide quota. Can we request a priority lane?
Ravi Patel: @Elena can we temporarily bump the "recompute-pool" quota for eng-platform to 200 vCPU equivalent? keep it limited to 2 hours.
Elena Gomez: I can approve a burst up to 150 vCPU now. 200 requires finance sign-off. Is 150 enough?
Jonah Lee: might be borderline but we can run with smarter shard sizing. Also need to ensure the routing policy pins the recompute jobs to eu-region shards to avoid cross-region IO costs.
Maya Chen: shard mapping note: use --shard-map eu-only and fanout=4. Example command: ```./recompute --start 2024-10-12T01:00Z --end 2024-10-12T03:00Z --shard-map eu-only --fanout 4 --idempotent true```
Priya Nair: add safeties: run a dry-run to emit counts only, compare to current aggregates, then run apply. Dry-run first should be low quota.
Ravi Patel: can we surface progress to the console? We need a temporary dashboard tile so PMs see live progress and we can detect regressions.
Jonah Lee: I'll add a dashboard row under "telemetry -> recomputes" with task-level progress + estimated time. Need a small API change to surface per-shard ETA, I'll push a tiny endpoint in the admin API.
Maya Chen: on quality: include eval set checks — run spot checks on sampled user sessions and ensure top N metrics match within 0.5%. If mismatch, abort and roll back.
Elena Gomez: approved quota bump to 150 vCPU. Also enabling priority lane for recompute jobs (tag: priority=recompute-engplatform). Audit log will record the change.
Priya Nair: ops-bot: creating runbook checklist and tagging oncall.
ops-bot: runbook created: https://internal.runbooks/recompute/1718001234 — assigned to @Jonah @Maya.
deploy-bot: note: there is a canary deploy scheduled at 04:00 UTC in eu that touches the admin API. Recommend pausing canary until recompute completes.
Ravi Patel: pause canary, thanks. Jonah, Maya — coordinate on dry-run first. Please post dry-run counts here once finished. @Priya keep an eye on quota burn. :eyes:
Jonah Lee: starting dry-run now, will post counts in ~15m.
Maya Chen: doing a small smoke sample on a 5m slice to validate transform logic.
Jonah Lee: dry-run complete: emitted counts for window. High-level diff: total events consistent, but user_agg_count differs by ~0.7% in top buckets.
Maya Chen: 0.7% is above our 0.5% threshold. digging — looks like a dedupe edge case when multiple retries had slightly different metadata. Fixing transform to prefer canonical_id field and re-run smoke.
Jonah Lee: re-run smoke done, diff now 0.2%. proceed to full recompute at throttle=0.5 (50% CPU) to stay within quota.
Priya Nair: monitoring quota burn: current projected peak 120 vCPU, within Elena's approval.
Ravi Patel: great. schedule: full recompute starts 03:45 UTC, expect ~90 minutes. We'll post completion and then swap aggregates. Priority lane, eu-only routing, dashboard tile live, audit logs recorded.
Maya Chen: once done I'll run validation suite and post summary artifacts.
Elena Gomez: leaving a note: please include an ops postmortem draft capturing root cause and improvements for retry backpressure.
Ravi Patel: agreed. I'll own the postmortem. Any objections to the rollback plan? we keep previous aggregate snapshot and a time-limited window to revert.
Jonah Lee: rollback plan clear. no objections.
Priya Nair: all set, monitoring channel opened. :thumbsup:
Ravi Patel: thanks everyone. I'll update channel after swap. :shipit:
